scripts.prepare: bun run scripts/gen-version.ts && bun run scripts/gen-web-bundle.ts
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/ui/tsconfig.json && tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.json && tsc -p apps/desktop/tsconfig.renderer.json && tsc -p apps/desktop/tsconfig.node.json && tsc -p e2e/desktop/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: bun --bun run vitest run --project node && vitest run --project react --project desktop-main --project desktop-renderer
scripts.build:binary: bun run scripts/gen-version.ts && pnpm --filter @hercule/web build && bun run scripts/check-bundle-budget.ts && bun run scripts/gen-web-bundle.ts && bun build packages/hercule/src/main.ts --compile --outfile hercule
scripts.build:desktop: pnpm --filter @hercule/desktop build && bun run scripts/check-bundle-budget.ts apps/desktop/out/renderer && bun run scripts/check-bundle-budget.ts --main-startup apps/desktop/out/main/index.js && pnpm --filter @hercule/desktop package
